understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to complete every level by moving each selectable piece onto a goal tile marked +; when multiple goals existed, all had to be occupied simultaneously for WIN.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Pieces moved in 3-pixel grid increments using directional actions, while walls or boundaries could block movement. Adjacent pushable blocks could be shifted by moving into them, and CLICK selected a selectable piece using its pixel coordinates, allowing control to switch between pieces. Movement hints were only heuristic, so blocked directions sometimes required testing.

understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to complete every level by moving each selectable piece onto a goal tile marked +; when multiple goals existed, all had to be occupied simultaneously for WIN.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Pieces moved in 3-pixel grid increments using directional actions, while walls or boundaries could block movement. Adjacent pushable blocks could be shifted by moving into them, and CLICK selected a selectable piece using its pixel coordinates, allowing control to switch between pieces. Movement hints were only heuristic, so blocked directions sometimes required testing.
